• Full Sail

rows.ARS:
White, near white or white blend Hybrid Tea.
Registration name: MAClanoflon
Exhibition name: Full Sail
rows.Origin:
Discovered by Samuel Darragh (1932-2019) McGredy IV (before 1994).
Introduced in New Zealand by McGredy Roses International (New Zealand) in 1998 as 'Full Sail'.
rows.Bloom: White or white blend. Creamy white. Strong fragrance. 26 to 40 petals. Average diameter 4.75". Large, full (26-40 petals), borne mostly solitary, high-centered to flat bloom form. Blooms in flushes throughout the season.
rows.Habit:
Medium, bushy, few or no prickles/thorns. Large, glossy, dark green foliage.

Height: 35" to 5' (90 to 150cm).
rows.Growing: USDA zone 7b and warmer. Can be used for cut flower or garden. Disease susceptibility: very disease resistant. Spring Pruning: Remove old canes and dead or diseased wood and cut back canes that cross. In warmer climates, cut back the remaining canes by about one-third. In colder areas, you'll probably find you'll have to prune a little more than that. Requires spring freeze protection (see glossary - Spring freeze protection) . Can be grown in the ground or in a container (container requires winter protection).
